screens_reviewed: Two scroll captures of the same Execute route (07-execute.png top, 08-execute-detail.png slightly scrolled) showing the submitted 'Maple Library Plaza' place: StatusBanner, header Card, 3 MetricCards, an offline/report Card, and the floating Start survey / Open report CTA row over the tab bar.
verdict: A clean, well-composed offline-first detail screen that correctly composes the shared primitives (StatusBanner, Card, ScreenHeader, Badge, MetricCard, AppButton) with token-driven spacing and a thumb-reachable dual CTA. The main real issue is a semantically wrong CloudOff (slashed-cloud) icon paired with 'Report available' on a submitted/online place. Layout and safe-area handling read correctly on iPhone; nothing is broken.

improvements.location: execute.tsx:162-172 (the 'Ready for offline capture' / 'Report available' Card header)
improvements.suggestion: When isSubmitted is true the header reads 'Report available' but still renders a CloudOff (cloud-off / slashed-cloud) icon, which signals 'offline/unavailable' next to an availability message — visible in 07-execute.png as a struck-through cloud beside 'Report available'. Swap the icon based on state: use a FileText/CheckCircle2 icon for the submitted 'Report available' case and reserve CloudOff for the 'Ready for offline capture' case.
improvements.evidence: execute.tsx:164 hardcodes `<CloudOff size={15} .../>` regardless of isSubmitted; image 07-execute.png shows the slashed cloud next to 'Report available'

improvements.suggestion: This card hand-rolls an icon + bold Paragraph header row plus a muted body Paragraph inline, duplicating the icon+title+subtitle pattern that ScreenHeader/ListRow already express. Consider routing it through a shared header/list primitive (or a small titled-section component) so the heading typography (fontSize 15 bodyBold here vs ScreenHeader/ListRow conventions) stays consistent with the rest of the design system.
improvements.evidence: execute.tsx:163-180 inline XStack+Paragraph; compare ScreenHeader (core.md:2348) and ListRow (core.md:2041) which standardize this pattern

improvements.suggestion: The floating CTA row positions with a fixed `bottom: 16` rather than deriving from useSafeAreaInsets(). It currently looks correct because the row sits above the tab bar, which already adds insets.bottom via getResponsiveTabBarLayout (responsive-layout.ts:703). It is safe today, but the magic 16 (and the paired `bottomPadding: 92` at execute.tsx:123) are hand-tuned constants; centralizing them (or tying bottom to a layout token) would keep the reserved scroll space and the CTA gap in sync if the tab bar height changes.
improvements.evidence: execute.tsx:190 `bottom: 16`; execute.tsx:123 `bottomPadding: 92`; tab bar inset handled in responsive-layout.ts:709-710

improvements.suggestion: The CTA row left/right use `layout.screenPaddingHorizontal` directly while the scroll content uses getResponsiveContentContainerStyle (which on tablet switches to centered adaptive gutters). On iPhone these agree (15pt), so there is no visible issue here; just noting the floating bar would not center-align with content on a tablet the way the scroll column does.

tamagui_notes: Spacing is token-driven: ScrollView container gap 20 + bottomPadding via getResponsiveContentContainerStyle (execute.tsx:121-124), Cards use p=$4/gap=$3, MetricCard row uses gap=$3 flexWrap=wrap (execute.tsx:153) — all consistent with PHONE_LAYOUT_TOKENS.

Colors come from designSystem tokens (tone.text, mutedForeground, foreground, primaryForeground) rather than hardcoded hex; the status Badge tone is resolved via getPlaceStatusTone (execute.tsx:97), matching the green 'SUBMITTED' pill in the image.

Shared primitives are used as intended (AppButton 52pt height per Button.tsx:1691, StatusBanner, Card, MetricCard, ScreenHeader, Badge) — minimal inline restyling except the offline/report card header row noted above.
platform_notes: Safe-area top: root Stack adds paddingTop:20 (app/_layout.tsx:1378) and the ScrollView uses contentInsetAdjustmentBehavior='automatic'; in both captures the StatusBanner clears the Dynamic Island with comfortable margin — no notch collision.
Thumb reach: the primary 'Open report' and secondary 'Start survey' CTAs are pinned to the bottom within easy thumb range; both are full 52pt AppButtons (>=44pt target).

Home indicator: the floating CTA sits above the tab bar, and the tab bar's paddingBottom includes insets.bottom (responsive-layout.ts:710), so the home indicator does not overlap interactive elements.
Compact-fit: the three MetricCards (Audits/Pending/Score) fit one row at iPhone width with flex={1}; flexWrap='wrap' guards larger text scales.
not_assessable: Offline / pending-sync states of StatusBanner and the offline-readiness Alert (only the online, 0-pending, submitted state is captured).
Draft / not_started variants of the CTA labels (Continue survey / Resume audit / Open audit) and tone — only the submitted state is shown.
Exact WCAG contrast ratios; the green 'Saved on Cloud' text and the green SUBMITTED pill on light surfaces look acceptable but were not measured.
Tablet centered-gutter behavior of the floating CTA bar (iPhone capture only).
score_rationale: Solid, ships with minor polish: faithful use of the shared design system, correct token spacing, and good iPhone safe-area/thumb-reach behavior, with no critical defects. Held below 9 by the genuinely misleading CloudOff icon on the 'Report available' state and a couple of hand-tuned constants / one inline-restyled card header that could route through existing primitives.
